info.title: Orderhive Attendance API
info.description:
API for integrating external systems with Orderhive's attendance module.

There are two endpoint groups:

**iClock / ADMS Protocol** (`/iclock/*`)
Implements the ZKTeco iClock HTTP Push (ADMS) protocol. Any device or software compatible with this protocol can push attendance punches. The device serial number (`SN` query parameter) must be pre-registered in the server's `ZKTECO_DEVICE_SN` environment variable.

**REST API** (`/api/*`)
Standard JSON endpoints for triggering server-side reconciliation. Protected by a shared Bearer token.

### Employee Code Mapping
Each punch carries a `userID` field that must match the `code` field of an employee record in the system (e.g. `INDG0194`). Punches with unrecognised codes are stored as unresolved and can be back-filled later.

### Reconciliation Rules
- **punchIn** — first punch of the day (HH:MM)
- **punchOut** — last punch of the day (HH:MM)
- **workingMinutes** — `punchOut − punchIn`, minimum 0
- **overtimeMinutes** — `max(0, workingMinutes − 480)`
- **status** — `present` if punchIn ≤ `LATE_THRESHOLD_TIME`, else `late`
- Records flagged `corrected: true` are never overwritten by biometric data

tags.name: iClock
tags.description: ZKTeco iClock / ADMS HTTP Push Protocol. Used by physical biometric devices and any iClock-compatible software.

tags.name: Reconciliation
tags.description: REST endpoints for triggering attendance reconciliation and absence marking.

get.description:
Called by the device on boot and periodically thereafter. Returns plain-text key=value configuration that controls push behaviour (timezone, sync interval, etc.).

The request is rejected with 401 if the `SN` value is not in the server's registered device whitelist.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Options flag sent by the device (e.g. `all`). Informational only.

200.description: ADMS configuration accepted by the device

text/plain.example:
GET OPTION FROM: JJA1253301000
ATTLOGStamp=9999
OPERLOGStamp=9999
ATTPHOTOStamp=9999
ErrorDelay=30
Delay=10
TransTimes=00:00;23:59
TransInterval=1
TransFlag=TransData AttLog
TimeZone=4.00
Realtime=1
Encrypt=None

post.description:
Called by the device (or an iClock-compatible integration) to deliver attendance punch records. Only requests with `table=ATTLOG` are processed; other table values receive an acknowledgement but no further action.

**Body format** — plain text, one punch per line, fields tab-separated:

```
userID<TAB>YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss<TAB>inOutMode<TAB>verifyType
```

Lines with fewer than 4 tab-separated fields, or with an invalid timestamp, are silently skipped.

**inOutMode values**: 0=check-in, 1=check-out, 2=break-out, 3=break-in, 4=OT-in, 5=OT-out

**verifyType values**: 1=fingerprint, 2=password, 3=card, 15=face

Punch documents are written with a deterministic ID (`{SN}_{userID}_{timestamp}`), so repeated POSTs of the same punch are idempotent.

parameters.name: table
parameters.description: Record type. Pass `ATTLOG` for attendance data.

schema.description: One punch per line, tab-separated: userID<TAB>YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss<TAB>inOutMode<TAB>verifyType

get.description: Called periodically by the device to check for pending server commands. Currently responds with `OK`.

parameters.name: INFO
parameters.description: Device information string (firmware version, IP, etc.). Informational only.

post.summary: Reconcile punches and mark absences for a date
post.description:
Intended for use as a nightly cron job.

**Step 1** — For every employee with a biometric punch on `date`, re-compute their attendance log.

**Step 2** — For every active employee with no log for `date`: mark `holiday`, `on-leave`, or `absent` as appropriate.

Records flagged `corrected: true` are never overwritten.

SN.name: SN
SN.description: Device serial number. Must be pre-registered in the server's `ZKTECO_DEVICE_SN` environment variable (comma-separated list). Requests from unregistered serial numbers are rejected with 401.

date.description: Date to reconcile in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to yesterday when omitted.

reconciled.description: Number of employees whose attendance log was updated

onLeave.description: Number of absent employees who were on approved leave

holiday.description: Whether the date was a configured holiday

BiometricPunch.description: A raw attendance punch stored in the system

deviceUserId.description: Employee code as enrolled on the device

branch.description: Office name derived from device SN mapping

processed.description: Whether this punch has been reconciled into an attendance log

AttendanceLog.description: Computed attendance record for an employee on a given date

corrected.description: If true, will not be overwritten by biometric reconciliation

BearerAuth.description: Value of the ZKTECO_CRON_SECRET environment variable configured on the server. Minimum 16 characters.
